title: Embers of the Fallen
summary: Kehlenn is bound, but not every hero walked away from the goat skull: the ones who did ride home for them.
when: flag.kehlenn_bound and flag.last_act_count >= 1 and not flag.ritual_all_gave

epilogue.title: The Last Act
epilogue.text: Where a hero gave their life at the Crooked Tree, the ash grows a ring of white flowers that no frost can touch.

epilogue.title: The Last Ride
epilogue.text: The Ghostlight Express comes for the living, and it keeps the empty seats beside them warm the whole way home.
